issuing_body: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services, U.S. Department of Health and Human Services
author: Centers for Medicare & Medicaid Services
title: Notice of Opportunity for Hearing on Compliance of Minnesota State Plan Provisions Concerning Program Integrity and Fraud, Waste, and Abuse With Title XIX (Medicaid) of the Social Security Act
notes: Federal Register document 2026-00512. The official notice embeds the January 6, 2026 CMS Administrator letter to Governor Tim Walz and supplies the previously missing section 1904 hearing notice provenance.
supports: CMS formally offered Minnesota an administrative hearing under section 1904 of the Social Security Act concerning substantial noncompliance findings tied to section 1902(a)(64) and 42 CFR Part 455, Subpart A.
The notice reproduces the January 6, 2026 letter to Governor Tim Walz, closing the prior gap where the letter's full text was available only through a third-party circulating reproduction.
CMS states that on December 5, 2025 it formally notified the Minnesota Medicaid Director of its concerns and directed the State to submit a comprehensive corrective action plan by December 31, 2025.
CMS states that its focused review concerned fourteen high-risk Medicaid services and describes a proposed federal financial participation withholding pending compliance.
does_not_support: That every suspected or improper Medicaid payment in Minnesota was fraudulent or criminal.
A final adjudication after hearing that Minnesota was noncompliant; the document is a notice and agency finding with an opportunity for hearing.
The March 19, 2026 CMS approval letter for Minnesota's revised corrective action plan.
